import struct
	import binascii
	
	log = system.util.getLogger("GEM630CTL_AUTOTAG")
	
	def hex_to_float32(h8):
	    b = binascii.unhexlify(h8)
	    return struct.unpack(">f", b)[0]   # change to "<f" if needed
	
	try:
	    hexString = currentValue.value
	    if hexString is None:
	        return
	
	    hexString = str(hexString).strip().lower()
	    if len(hexString) < 60:
	        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_HexDebug"], ["HEX too short: " + str(len(hexString))])
	        return
	
	    # --- Serial No ---
	    serialNo_dec = int(hexString[0:8], 16)
	
	    # --- Folder ---
	    serialFolder = "[default]Meter/GEM630CTL/" + str(serialNo_dec)
	
	    # Create folder if missing
	    if not system.tag.exists(serialFolder):
	        results = system.tag.configure(
	            "[default]Meter/GEM630CTL",
	            [{"name": str(serialNo_dec), "tagType": "Folder"}],
	            "i"
	        )
	        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_HexDebug"], ["FOLDER: " + str(results)])
	
	    # Create Name tag FIRST (fixed: Name vs _Name mismatch)
	    nameTagPath = serialFolder + "/Name"
	    if not system.tag.exists(nameTagPath):
	        results = system.tag.configure(
	            serialFolder,
	            [{
	                "name": "_Name",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "memory",
	                "dataType": "String",
	                "value": "",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"	                
	            }],
	            "i"
	        )
	        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_HexDebug"], ["NAME TAG: " + str(results)])
	
	    msgFrgNo_raw = hexString[8:10]
	
	    raw_values = [
	        hexString[12:20],
	        hexString[20:28],
	        hexString[28:36],
	        hexString[36:44],
	        hexString[44:52],
	        hexString[52:60]
	    ]
	    values = [hex_to_float32(x) for x in raw_values]
	
	    if msgFrgNo_raw == "01":
	        labels = ["V1","V2","V3","V12","V23","V31"]
	    elif msgFrgNo_raw == "02":
	        labels = ["I1","I2","I3","In","Hz","Wh_Im"]
	    elif msgFrgNo_raw == "03":
	        labels = ["PF1","PF2","PF3","P1","P2","P3"]
	    elif msgFrgNo_raw == "04":
	        labels = ["Q1","Q2","Q3","S1","S2","S3"]
	    elif msgFrgNo_raw == "05":
	        labels = ["THDV1","THDV2","THDV3","THDA1","THDA2","THDA3"]
	    else:
	        labels = ["Param1","Param2","Param3","Param4","Param5","Param6"]
	
	    # =========================================================
	    # Apply scaling (FIXED: do NOT use startswith("P") because PF* will be hit)
	    # P/Q/S -> /1000
	    # Wh_Im -> /1000
	    # THD   -> /100
	    # =========================================================
	    SCALE_1000 = set(["P1","P2","P3","Q1","Q2","Q3","S1","S2","S3"])
	    scaled_values = []
	
	    for name, val in zip(labels, values):
	        if name in SCALE_1000:
	            val = val / 1000.0
	        elif name.startswith("THD"):
	            val = val / 100.0
	        # PF1/PF2/PF3 will stay unchanged (0.9xx)
	        scaled_values.append(val)
	
	    values = scaled_values
	
	    # =========================================================
	    # 1) Create missing NORMAL tags first (memory Float4)
	    # =========================================================
	    toCreate = []
	    for name in labels:
	        fullPath = serialFolder + "/" + name
	        if not system.tag.exists(fullPath):
	            toCreate.append({
	                "name": name,
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "memory",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "value": 0.0,
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    if toCreate:
	        results = system.tag.configure(serialFolder, toCreate, "i")
	        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_HexDebug"], ["CONFIG1: " + str(results)])
	
	    # =========================================================
	    # 2) Create SYS tags (Expression) in a second step
	    # =========================================================
	    sysCreate = []
	
	    # Ptot
	    if ("P1" in labels and "P2" in labels and "P3" in labels):
	        ptotPath = serialFolder + "/Ptot"
	        if not system.tag.exists(ptotPath):
	            sysCreate.append({
	                "name": "Ptot",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "expr",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "expression": "tag(\"[.]P1\") + tag(\"[.]P2\") + tag(\"[.]P3\")",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    # Qtot
	    if ("Q1" in labels and "Q2" in labels and "Q3" in labels):
	        qtotPath = serialFolder + "/Qtot"
	        if not system.tag.exists(qtotPath):
	            sysCreate.append({
	                "name": "Qtot",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "expr",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "expression": "tag(\"[.]Q1\") + tag(\"[.]Q2\") + tag(\"[.]Q3\")",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    # Stot
	    if ("S1" in labels and "S2" in labels and "S3" in labels):
	        stotPath = serialFolder + "/Stot"
	        if not system.tag.exists(stotPath):
	            sysCreate.append({
	                "name": "Stot",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "expr",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "expression": "tag(\"[.]S1\") + tag(\"[.]S2\") + tag(\"[.]S3\")",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    # Vsys
	    if ("V1" in labels and "V2" in labels and "V3" in labels):
	        vsysPath = serialFolder + "/Vsys"
	        if not system.tag.exists(vsysPath):
	            sysCreate.append({
	                "name": "Vsys",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "expr",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "expression": "(tag(\"[.]V1\") + tag(\"[.]V2\") + tag(\"[.]V3\")) / 3",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    # PFsys (avg PF1-3)  ✅ now PF values are not scaled anymore
	    if ("PF1" in labels and "PF2" in labels and "PF3" in labels):
	        pfsysPath = serialFolder + "/PFsys"
	        if not system.tag.exists(pfsysPath):
	            sysCreate.append({
	                "name": "PFsys",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "expr",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "expression": "(tag(\"[.]PF1\") + tag(\"[.]PF2\") + tag(\"[.]PF3\")) / 3",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    # Isys
	    if ("I1" in labels and "I2" in labels and "I3" in labels):
	        isysPath = serialFolder + "/Isys"
	        if not system.tag.exists(isysPath):
	            sysCreate.append({
	                "name": "Isys",
	                "tagType": "AtomicTag",
	                "valueSource": "expr",
	                "dataType": "Float4",
	                "expression": "(tag(\"[.]I1\") + tag(\"[.]I2\") + tag(\"[.]I3\")) / 3",
	                "historyEnabled": True,
	                "historyProvider":"DemoHistorian"
	            })
	
	    if sysCreate:
	        results = system.tag.configure(serialFolder, sysCreate, "i")
	        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_HexDebug"], ["CONFIG2: " + str(results)])
	
	    # --- Write values ---
	    writePaths = [serialFolder + "/" + name for name in labels]
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(writePaths, values)
	
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(
	        ["[.]GEM630CTL_HexDebug"],
	        ["OK serial=" + str(serialNo_dec) + " frag=" + msgFrgNo_raw]
	    )
	
	except Exception as e:
	    log.error("AutoTag failed: " + str(e))
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Debug"], ["FAIL: " + str(e)])

import base64, binascii, re
    logger = system.util.getLogger("GEM630CTL_DECODE")

    try:
        s = currentValue.value
        if s is None:
            system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Hex"], [""])
            system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Debug"], ["EMPTY"])
            return

        s = re.sub(r"\s+", "", str(s).strip())
        if s == "":
            system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Hex"], [""])
            system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Debug"], ["BLANK"])
            return

        # pad base64 if missing
        pad = (-len(s)) % 4
        if pad:
            s += "=" * pad

        # support url-safe base64 too
        b = base64.b64decode(s, altchars=b"-_")
        hexString = binascii.hexlify(b).decode("utf-8")

        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Hex"], [hexString])
        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Debug"], ["OK len=" + str(len(hexString))])

    except Exception as e:
        system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]GEM630CTL_Debug"], ["FAIL: " + str(e)])
        logger.error("Decode failed: " + str(e))
